title: Nourishing Turkish Rice Paper Soup
description: A peppery, airy Turkish soup that uses rice paper sheets and fresh vegetables to create a light, sattvic-friendly broth.
instructions: Fill the cazuela with 4 cups of water and 4 cups of low-sodium vegetable broth, bring to a gentle boil.
Add cumin seeds, coriander seeds, and black pepper to the boiling liquid.
Thinly slice one medium carrot and one medium zucchini, and add them to the pot.
Let the vegetables simmer for 5 minutes until slightly tender.
While the veggies cook, soak the rice paper sheets in warm water for 30 seconds until pliable, then slice them into thin strips.
Add the sliced carrots, zucchini, and 2 cups of fresh spinach to the pot, cooking for another 3 minutes.
Stir in 2 minced garlic cloves, and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in 1 tablespoon of lemon juice and 1 teaspoon of olive oil, stir gently.
Toss in the sliced rice paper strips, simmer for 2 minutes until the dough is translucent.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley, remove from heat, and serve hot.
